name: Ferruginous-Cwm
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a subterranean ocean, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in nitrogen here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
